scope: Only four CLI product files. Main repository, docs, harness, vendor, Cargo files and shared target untouched.

check_provenance: Source bytes were unchanged after implementation throughout these checks and at commit. No per-command pre-run manifest was captured; root full frozen gates remain separate.
implementation_boundaries: Unix signal pair created synchronously before first await/helper IO; object remains live through cleanup/final output.
Only listener-free physical prepare is cancelled, signal-first biased. Bind is not raced.
EventOutput created before bind. Every post-bind operation result passes through awaited server.shutdown; cleanup error takes precedence.
Repeated signals cannot discard cleanup; pending new signal can skip/cancel final stopped output after cleanup.
Non-Unix ctrl_c retained. No SIGKILL, abort or durable restart recovery claim. Cancelling prepare does not stop already-running blocking syscalls.
runtime_validation: No child signal/backpressure or QEMU run by implementation agent; root owns official new child harness and old-product/QEMU reproduction.
